sections.overview: This large South American catfish occurs in the Amazon and Orinoco river basins.
sections.identification: It has an elongated body, a flattened head and long barbels; records report up to 150 cm standard length.
sections.habitat: FishBase classifies it as a tropical, freshwater, demersal fish.
sections.diet: It feeds mainly on small fishes and invertebrates.
sections.reproduction: The sources used here provide no species-specific account of its spawning or young.
sections.ecology: Its large river-basin range spans the Amazon and Orinoco systems; local conservation concerns can differ between basins.
sections.conservation: FishBase reports a global IUCN assessment of Least Concern from 2020. The USGS profile notes an earlier report of vulnerability in the Orinoco basin.
